cn.title: 业务反应与风险缓冲需要分开检验
cn.subtitle: FICC与ECS 反馈复核及补充关联分析

sections.heading: 结论与业务含义
paragraphs: 我们建议将业务反应和缓冲充足度分开检验。新增保证金追缴、变动保证金支付和季末保证金变化后，部分相关性变为正，但关系仍随指标、滞后和样本时期变化。目前证据支持继续监测与核查，尚不足以建立稳定的业务风险评分。
GSD 的10年国债日变动绝对值与同季度保证金环比变化，全样本 rho 为0.408；较早样本为0.441，后续六季度为−0.147。全样本普通BH校正 q 为0.172，因此这个正相关没有通过5%的多重检验门槛。
新增检验有294个比较组合，每组分别报告较早、后续和全样本结果，共882条统计记录。全样本48项通过普通BH 5%，其中24项同时呈正相关且四季度区块bootstrap区间高于零；较早样本没有比较通过普通BH 5%。这些是事后扩展的探索性结果，普通p值也未充分处理季度序列依赖，不能把24项解读成已验证的24条传导通道。
本次提取了23个季度、3个清算服务的207个新增原始字段值。原来的事件检验、结果指标、门槛和文件均保留；本轮不重新分配风险权重，也不把新增结果转换为违约概率或官方风险等级。

sections.heading: Claude反馈中可以采纳和需要修正的内容
paragraphs: 可以采纳的建议是区分业务反应与缓冲充足度，同时报告同季度与下一季度关系，补充早期披露，并处理十二个月窗口重叠。原来的4.4.3除以6.1.1可以保留为脆弱度候选，但不宜单独承担冲击是否到达业务的验证。4.4.3本身已是超过初始保证金的压力损失，并非完整的总压力损失。
负相关不能直接证明风控有效。提高保证金可以使比值下降，但持仓、业务规模、模型参数、观察窗口和其他变化也可能造成同样结果。只有把相关调整及暴露变化放入证据链，才能进一步解释原因。
我们原分析已有同季度和分子分母诊断。GSD国债日变动与损失比的全样本同季度rho为0.209，较早样本约为−0.291。只引用全样本正值会掩盖关系的不稳定；同季度相关也不能单独证明某个具体事件造成业务变化。
SVB窗口内SOFR−EFFR峰值为0bp，不是2023年全年的峰值。冻结的日度数据中，全年峰值约为7bp。缺少2019年及2020年初当季PQD限制事件配对，但2020Q4的部分十二个月披露可能包含疫情期，不能说样本完全没有包含疫情压力。
阈值排除当天、时间顺序分组、BH校正和区块bootstrap确实提高了可复核性，但原始历史版本和首次发布日期仍未核实。目录日期是公开可用时间的代理；因此不能把本次研究称为已经严格完成了历史时点回测。

sections.heading: 新增结果指标与准确口径
paragraphs: IM指初始保证金，VM指变动保证金，PQD指公开量化披露。原始新增字段是6.6.1日均变动保证金支付、6.7.1最大单日变动保证金支付和6.8.1最大单日初始保证金追缴。它们的观察窗口均为报告季度。6.1.1是季末保证金要求存量。以下七种形式均来自这些字段，分别检验，不按结果挑选最终指标。
DTCC说明GSD和MBSD的VM是会员之间的现金传递，NSCC的VM收费属于清算基金要求；这些金额都不能直接当成DTCC收入或实际亏损。6.8.1反映相对于已存抵押品的最大汇总缺口和实际追缴，包含日内追缴，并非保证金要求总量的最大增幅。

sections.heading: 同季度和下一季度的补充结果
paragraphs: 表中的六个案例在本轮统计运行前按经济通道和反馈问题指定，用来展示不同指标的含义，并非从最大正相关中挑选。较早期的结果季度截至2024Q4；后续期为2025Q1至2026Q2，只有六对有效观察。后续期已被查看，不是新的盲测样本。
对保证金环比变化来说，国债冲击的全样本同季度方向为正，可能与保证金需求反应一致；但q值、时期反转和业务规模影响使证据仍不充分。最大追缴除以季末保证金仍呈负相关，说明换一个看起来更直接的比例并不自动解决问题。
MBSD国债冲击与VM峰值在后续六期的同季度rho为0.736，但较早期仅0.053，全样本为0.200。NSCC的VIX与VM峰值同季度全样本rho为0.326，后续期约−0.029。小样本中的高相关需要保留，不应据此宣布传导成立。
下一季度使用季度t的完整最大冲击；这一值只能在季度结束后确定。因此这些结果是历史关联诊断，不能直接用作事件发生当日的实时预测。

sections.heading: 验证方法与证据边界
paragraphs: 原七个候选指标中四个通过原事件筛选；本轮业务反应诊断没有改变这一结果，也不代表全部候选已经通过双重检验。复用原七个日度指标与季度最大值，不改变原事件窗口或报警阈值。分别对GSD、MBSD、NSCC，七个外部指标、七种业务反应形式、两种滞后进行比较。每个样本组294项普通Spearman p值统一进行BH校正，表中q由完整比较族计算，不只对展示案例计算。
至少12对且具有足够不同值时，计算四个连续日历季度的移动区块bootstrap，重复2000次，给出95%区间。后续六期仅描述rho，不满足该门槛。另做按日历季度对齐的一阶差分诊断，帮助检查名义金额趋势；差分结果也不替代业务暴露和模型变更控制。
比例分子与分母可能不是同一天：季度峰值追缴对季末IM是近似尺度化。VM峰值除以日均衡量峰值集中程度；当整个季度持续高压时，日均也会升高。所有比例均同时保留原始金额，缺失不填零。
季度业务规模、会员结构和风险模型调整尚未控制。PQD金额汇总不能定位事件发生日，T12m压力指标又存在窗口重叠。相关系数回答共同变化，不能识别因果，也不能证明乘法结构改善了模型。

sections.heading: 下一阶段的数据和实施安排
paragraphs: 先冻结本轮定义和全部结果，再收集新增、未参与这次解释的数据用于后续验证。已看过的2025Q1至2026Q2不能重新命名为独立最终测试集。
优先补充2019年及2020年初的PQD和历史原始版本，核实首次发布日期；再争取按日的保证金要求、追缴、VM支付、可用流动性与覆盖不足记录。历史公开文件可以继续检索；向项目方索取资料时，应明确公开或可批准使用的范围。
FICC分别补充GSD国债及回购暴露、MBSD的MBS利差和久期凸性环境；ECS保持NSCC清算与DTC结算证据独立。MOVE完整日度历史和MBS专属数据仍是缺口，本报告不扩展到DAS或其他运营风险的已验证评分。
监测输出可先采用事件卡片，列明事件、业务、通道、外部指标变化、当时可获得的脆弱度和证据强度。自动权重、统一0至100评分和业务损失预测需等更稳定的验证结果。

sections.heading: 数据来源与复现
paragraphs: 数据观察截至2026Q2，报告日期为2026年10月6日。原始市场及PQD文件采集于10月5日至6日；本轮复用冻结文件，新增提取字段，没有下载到更早季度的PQD。
PQD共22份XLSX和2024Q4官方PDF，覆盖2020Q4至2026Q2。2024Q4新增值来自第13页，原单位USD MM乘以1000000转为USD；每项原值、单元格或页码、下载URL与SHA256保留在response_cell_evidence.csv和source_manifest.json。
官方定义见CPMI–IOSCO公开量化披露标准，以及各季度DTCC说明。方法参考项目Quant-tech的样本外评估及过拟合控制原则。本轮独立目录保留分析计划、207项字段证据、69行季度面板、逐对关联证据和882条统计结果。

en.title: Business responses and risk buffers need separate tests
en.subtitle: FICC and ECS feedback review and supplemental association analysis

sections.heading: Conclusion and business implication
paragraphs: Business responses and risk-buffer adequacy should be tested separately. Adding margin calls, variation margin payments and changes in quarter-end initial margin produces some positive relationships, but associations still change with the outcome, lag and sample period. The evidence supports continued monitoring and investigation; it does not yet support a stable business risk score.

For GSD, the full-sample same-quarter correlation between the absolute daily change in the 10-year Treasury yield and quarter-on-quarter initial margin growth is 0.408. It is 0.441 through 2024Q4 and −0.147 in the following six quarters. Its full-sample ordinary BH-adjusted q-value is 0.172, above the 5% multiple-testing threshold.

There are 294 comparison combinations, each reported for the earlier, later and full samples, producing 882 statistical records. In the full sample, 48 comparisons meet ordinary BH 5%; 24 also have a positive correlation and a four-quarter block-bootstrap interval above zero. No earlier-sample comparison meets ordinary BH 5%. These are post-result exploratory extensions. Ordinary p-values do not adequately address quarterly dependence, and the 24 comparisons must not be presented as 24 validated transmission channels.

The extension extracts 207 new raw field values across 23 quarters and three clearing services. The original event tests, outcomes, thresholds and files are preserved. This report does not reassign risk weights or interpret the new statistics as default probabilities or official risk grades.

sections.heading: What to adopt and correct in the feedback
paragraphs: Adopt the separation of business responses from buffer adequacy, report same-quarter and next-quarter associations separately, seek earlier disclosures, and account for overlapping twelve-month windows. The original 4.4.3 / 6.1.1 ratio may remain a vulnerability candidate, but should not alone establish that a shock reached the business. Item 4.4.3 already measures stress loss in excess of initial margin, rather than total gross stress loss.

A negative correlation does not demonstrate effective risk management. Increasing initial margin can reduce the ratio, but positions, business scale, model parameters, reporting windows and other changes can produce a similar result. The explanation requires evidence of exposures and actual risk-management changes.

The original analysis already includes same-quarter and numerator/denominator diagnostics. For GSD Treasury yield changes versus the stress-loss ratio, the full-sample same-quarter rho is 0.209, while the earlier-sample value is approximately −0.291. Quoting only the positive full-sample value hides instability. Contemporaneous correlation also cannot identify the effect of a particular event.

The SOFR−EFFR peak of 0bp applies to the specified SVB event window, not the whole of 2023. The frozen daily data show a full-year peak of approximately 7bp. Missing contemporaneous PQD for 2019 and early 2020 limits event matching, but some 2020Q4 trailing-twelve-month disclosures may include the pandemic period.

Excluding the current observation from thresholds, chronological grouping, BH correction and block bootstrap improve reproducibility. However, original historical vintages and first-release dates remain unverified. Directory listing dates proxy public availability, so this is not a fully validated point-in-time backtest.

sections.heading: New response measures and field definitions
paragraphs: IM means initial margin, VM means variation margin, and PQD means public quantitative disclosure. The new raw fields are 6.6.1 average daily variation margin paid, 6.7.1 maximum variation margin paid on a business day, and 6.8.1 maximum aggregate initial margin call on a business day. Their observation windows are the reporting quarter. Item 6.1.1 is quarter-end initial margin required. Seven formulations derived from these fields are compared separately, without selecting a final measure from the observed fit.

DTCC explains that VM is a cash pass-through process across GSD and MBSD members, while NSCC VM charges form part of clearing fund requirements. These amounts are not DTCC revenue or realized business losses. Item 6.8.1 represents the largest aggregate deficit over collateral already deposited and the actual call, including intraday calls; it is not the maximum increase in total margin requirements.

sections.heading: Supplemental same-quarter and next-quarter results
paragraphs: The six displayed examples were specified before this extension was run, based on economic channels and the feedback questions. They were not selected from the largest positive correlations. The earlier sample ends at target quarter 2024Q4; the later sample covers 2025Q1–2026Q2 and has only six valid pairs. The later period has already been viewed and is not a new blind test.

The full-sample positive same-quarter Treasury-shock correlation with initial margin growth is consistent with a margin-demand response, but its q-value, period reversal and possible business-scale effects leave the evidence inconclusive. Peak margin calls scaled by quarter-end margin remain negatively correlated: using a more direct-looking ratio does not automatically resolve the identification problem.

For MBSD, the same-quarter Treasury-shock correlation with peak VM is 0.736 in the later six quarters, compared with 0.053 earlier and 0.200 overall. For NSCC, the same-quarter VIX correlation with peak VM is 0.326 overall and approximately −0.029 later. Retain these small-sample results, but do not interpret a high coefficient as established transmission.

Next-quarter comparisons use the completed quarter-t maximum external indicator, which becomes known only after quarter-end. They are historical association diagnostics, not an event-day real-time forecast.

sections.heading: Validation method and evidence limits
paragraphs: Four of the original seven candidates passed the original event screen. This extension does not change that finding or establish that every candidate has passed both tests. Reuse the original seven daily transformations and quarterly maxima; do not change the original event windows or alarm thresholds. Compare seven external indicators with seven response formulations and two lags separately for GSD, MBSD and NSCC. Apply BH to all 294 ordinary Spearman p-values within each sample. Displayed q-values come from the complete comparison family, not just the displayed cases.

For at least twelve pairs with adequate distinct values, use moving blocks of four consecutive calendar quarters, 2000 replicates and a 95% interval. The later six-quarter sample is descriptive and does not meet this threshold. Calendar-aligned first differences help examine nominal-value trends, but do not substitute for controls for exposures and model changes.

Ratio components may be measured on different days: the quarter peak call divided by quarter-end IM is approximate scaling. Peak/average VM measures concentration of peak payments; average VM can also rise during sustained quarterly stress. Retain raw amounts alongside ratios and never replace missing observations with zero.

Business scale, membership composition and margin-model changes remain uncontrolled. Quarterly aggregates cannot locate the event day; trailing-twelve-month stress outcomes overlap. Correlations describe co-movement, not causality, and do not validate the external-shock-times-vulnerability structure.

sections.heading: Data priorities and implementation
paragraphs: Freeze the definitions and complete results, then collect new evidence that has not contributed to this interpretation. The already-viewed 2025Q1–2026Q2 period cannot be relabeled an independent final test set.

Prioritize 2019 and early-2020 PQD, original historical versions and verified first-release dates. Seek daily margin requirements, calls, VM payments, available liquidity and coverage breaches. Earlier public files can be searched; any project-team data request should clearly specify public or otherwise approved data scope.

For FICC, keep GSD Treasury/repo exposures separate from MBSD MBS spreads and duration/convexity conditions. For ECS, preserve the distinction between NSCC clearing and DTC settlement evidence. Complete MOVE histories and dedicated MBS data remain gaps. This report does not establish DAS or operational-risk scoring.

Use event cards initially: event, business, channel, external indicator change, vulnerability available at that time, and evidence strength. Automated weights, a common 0–100 scale and business-loss forecasts require more stable validation.

sections.heading: Sources and reproducibility
paragraphs: The observation cutoff is 2026Q2 and the report date is October 6, 2026. Original market and PQD files were collected on October 5–6. This extension reuses frozen files and extracts additional fields; it does not add earlier PQD quarters.

The PQD inputs are 22 XLSX files and the official 2024Q4 PDF, covering 2020Q4–2026Q2. New 2024Q4 values come from page 13, with USD MM multiplied by 1000000 to obtain USD. Raw values, cells or pages, download URLs and SHA256 hashes are retained in response_cell_evidence.csv and source_manifest.json.

Definitions are checked against the CPMI–IOSCO public quantitative disclosure standards and DTCC quarterly explanatory notes. Validation principles follow the project Quant-tech material on out-of-sample evaluation and overfitting. The separate extension directory retains the plan, 207 field-evidence records, a 69-row quarterly panel, paired observations and all 882 statistical records.
